name: steam_turbine_baumann
title: Steam turbine with Baumann wet-expansion efficiency correction
summary: Isentropic efficiency of a steam turbine expanding into the vapour dome: the dry efficiency holds until the saturated-vapour line, the wet part is penalised by the Baumann rule eta_s = eta_s_dry*(1 - alpha*y_m); the saturation crossing is solved by two equations. Seven cases of the TESPy docstring and tests.

authors: tlmerbecks (GitHub handle of the contributor of the first version)

verification.summary: Re-run of the TESPy docstring example and of test_SteamTurbine / test_SteamTurbine_outlet_near_saturation (tespy 0.11.3.dev0, CoolProp 8.0.0): 44 common variables over 7 cases, 0 differ at rtol=0.001, max relative deviation 1.71e-09. Docstring values reproduced (P = 7009682 W, x = 0.84).
verification.reference: TESPy SteamTurbine class docstring (eta_s_dry = 0.9, alpha = 1: P = -7009682 W, x = 0.84) and tests/test_components/test_turbomachinery.py, commit 19425523, re-run in a throw-away virtual environment
verification.notes: 44 common variables (eta_s, x_out, W_dot, h_in, h_out, s_in, P_out of the cases), 0 differ at rtol=1e-3; largest deviation P_out_6 1.71e-09.
